name: arca-life-sciences
description: Search Arca's public life-sciences corpus: FDA drug and device records, clinical trials, PubMed literature, VAERS, CDC data, and EU/PMDA device vigilance.

interface.longDescription:
Arca FDA, Trials & PubMed searches public regulatory, clinical, and scientific records and links to the original source.

What you can search:
- FDA drug records: labels, Drugs@FDA approvals and review documents, complete response letters, warning letters, Form 483s, inspections, import refusals, Orange Book, Purple Book, NDC, drug shortages, and postmarket requirements
- FDA device records: 510(k), PMA, registrations, GUDID, and MAUDE adverse event reports
- ClinicalTrials.gov studies
- PubMed and Europe PMC literature, ranked with citation counts and open-access status
- VAERS, CDC public-health data, EU expert panels, and BfArM/PMDA device vigilance

Narrow FDA enforcement searches, FDA guidance, complete response letters, 510(k)/PMA decisions, Health Canada records, EudraGMDP certificates, EU MDR/IVDR expert-panel opinions and BfArM/PMDA notices by record date and exact identifiers. Filter labels by SPL effective date and application or NDC identifiers. Filter ClinicalTrials.gov studies by phase, recruitment status and study milestones. Posting dates stay separate from record dates; trial milestones retain actual or estimated qualifiers. PubMed supports year and publication-type filters. These filters do not cover every source. Missing dates are not guessed, and incomplete metadata is reported.

For regulatory affairs, quality, pharmacovigilance, clinical and medical-affairs research.

Limitations: Arca only searches public records it mirrors. It has no access to your documents, patient data or non-public FDA correspondence. It is read-only and cannot file reports or submissions. Results are research material, not medical advice.
capabilities: Search FDA drug and device records
Read the full text of a source record

Find recruiting Phase 3 trials of tirzepatide in heart failure.
What does the Ozempic label's boxed warning say?

positive.description: Filter FDA enforcement records by their record date
positive.prompt: Find FDA Form 483 observations for sterile injectable manufacturers with record dates in 2025. Exclude records dated in other years.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses publicSourceFilters with recordTypes containing 483, dateField recordDate, startDate 2025-01-01 and endDate 2025-12-31. Does not rely on a year in the query text. Returned matches have record dates in the requested range. Missing dates are excluded and disclosed. If metadata coverage is incomplete, reports that filtered search is not ready rather than presenting an empty or partial answer as complete. Cites the original FDA records.

positive.description: Keep an exact label identifier separate from the effective date
positive.prompt: Find drug labels for application NDA209637 with SPL effective dates in 2025. Use the application identifier exactly, not a text-only match.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses publicSourceFilters.applicationNumbers containing NDA209637 and a recordDate range covering 2025. Treats the application identifier as a string. Uses the SPL effective date, not the page posting date. Returns only exact matches, or explains that no matching records were found or metadata is not ready. Does not invent a label or substitute another date.

positive.description: Filter trial milestones without confusing estimates with completed events
positive.prompt: Find recruiting Phase 3 interventional trials of tirzepatide in heart failure whose primary completion date is in 2027. Tell me whether each date is actual or estimated.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses trialPhases PHASE3, trialStatuses RECRUITING, studyTypes INTERVENTIONAL and a primaryCompletionDate range covering 2027. Does not filter on first submission or public posting instead. Preserves each returned ACTUAL or ESTIMATED qualifier and does not call an estimated milestone a completed event. Excludes partial dates that lack day precision. Reports no matches or incomplete metadata honestly and links any matches to ClinicalTrials.gov.

positive.description: Filter FDA guidance and complete response letters by record date
positive.prompt: Find FDA complete response letters and FDA guidance documents dated in 2024 about manufacturing facility inspections.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses publicSourceFilters with recordTypes covering COMPLETE RESPONSE LETTER and FDA GUIDANCE, dateField recordDate, startDate 2024-01-01 and endDate 2024-12-31, with sourceTypes regulatory_guidance. Does not rely on a year in the query text. Records without a full date are excluded and disclosed. If metadata is incomplete, reports that filtered search is not ready rather than presenting a partial answer as complete. Cites the original FDA documents.

positive.description: Filter EU and Health Canada records by exact country or certificate type
positive.prompt: Find EudraGMDP GMP certificates and Health Canada notices of compliance with record dates in 2025.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses publicSourceFilters with recordTypes for GMP CERTIFICATE and NOC, dateField recordDate, and a 2025 date range, with sourceTypes global_regulatory. Treats identifiers as strings. Excludes records without a full date and discloses it. If metadata is incomplete, reports that filtered search is not ready instead of returning an empty or partial answer. Cites the original regulator pages.

positive.description: Look up Orange Book patents and exclusivities
positive.prompt: Which patents and exclusivities are listed in the Orange Book for Ozempic?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Orange Book listing for Ozempic (semaglutide, NDAs 209637 and 213051) with its patent numbers, patent expiration dates, and any exclusivity codes, with a link to the FDA Orange Book.

positive.description: Read a drug label's boxed warning
positive.prompt: What does the boxed warning on the Ozempic label say?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Ozempic (semaglutide) label, reads the full record, and quotes the boxed warning on the risk of thyroid C-cell tumors, with a DailyMed link.

positive.description: Find clinical trials for a drug and indication
positive.prompt: Find Phase 3 trials of tirzepatide in heart failure.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns ClinicalTrials.gov studies of tirzepatide in heart failure, including the SUMMIT trial (NCT04847557), with links to clinicaltrials.gov.

positive.description: Find systematic reviews in the literature
positive.prompt: Find meta-analyses on tirzepatide and pancreatitis or gallbladder risk.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns PubMed systematic reviews or meta-analyses on tirzepatide safety, including pancreatitis and gallbladder or biliary disease, with year, journal, PMID, and citation metadata.

positive.prompt: Show me MAUDE adverse event reports for insulin pump malfunctions.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns MAUDE device adverse event reports describing insulin pump malfunctions (for example MiniMed and Paradigm pumps), each with its report number and a link to the openFDA record.

negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn in New York.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any Arca tool, because the request has nothing to do with regulatory, clinical, or scientific records.

negative.description: Request for private data the plugin cannot access
negative.prompt: Look up my prescription history and tell me which of my medications interact.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not search for personal records. Explains that the plugin only covers public regulatory and scientific data and has no access to personal health information.

negative.description: Request to take an action the plugin cannot perform
negative.prompt: File an adverse event report with the FDA for the reaction I had to my vaccine.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not claim to file anything, because the plugin is read-only. Points the user to FDA MedWatch or VAERS to submit the report themselves.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds structured date and identifier filters for FDA enforcement records, drug labels, FDA guidance, complete response letters, 510(k)/PMA decisions, Health Canada, EudraGMDP, EU MDR/IVDR expert-panel opinions and BfArM/PMDA notices, plus ClinicalTrials.gov phase, recruitment status and study milestones. Record dates stay separate from public posting dates. Trial milestones retain actual or estimated qualifiers. PubMed searches support year and publication-type filters. Missing dates are not guessed, and filtered search reports incomplete metadata instead of silently omitting records. Adds review cases for these filters. Public, read-only data access and privacy behavior are unchanged; the v1.0.1 privacy notes (policy Section 5, case 16598479) still apply.
